daily_summary: 本日变更集中在 Triton 语言前端 min/max/argmin/argmax 归约算法重构（改为两阶段：先原生 min/max 归约求值，再最小索引归约定位下标，并新增 propagate_nan 参数）、FPSan 浮点消毒器对比较（cmpf）和绝对值（absf）的 payload 语义支持、以及若干工具与后端修复（AMD fp64/f16 buffer atomic swap 以整数宽度交换、AOT 启动器浮点标量 ABI 宽度对齐、解释器 tuple 归约全轴修复、LLVM 构建升级以支持 NVPTX fptrunc.round）。整体方向是提升语言语义一致性与 sanitizer 覆盖度、修复后端/工具链的具体代码生成缺陷。
ascend_impact_summary: 本日有 3 个 commit 会直接影响 triton-ascend：(1) argmin/argmax 两阶段重构移除 core.py 的 _reduce_with_indices 并改写 standard.py 的 min/max、新增 propagate_nan 参数，命中必然影响路径 python/triton/language/；(2) 解释器 tuple 归约全轴修复修改 python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py 的 ReduceOps.unravel/generic_reduce，命中必然影响路径，AscendInterpreterBuilder/AscendReduceOps 需同步验证；(3) AOT 浮点标量 ABI 宽度对齐修改 third_party/nvidia 与 third_party/amd 的 driver.py ty_to_cpp（属绝不影哬路径），但同一目录树下的测试结构可能被 Ascend 复用参考，实际不影响 Ascend 后端。其余 FPSan（TritonInstrument 专属，Ascend 不使用）与 LLVM 构建（CI/构建基础设施）不影响 Ascend。argmin/argmax 重构与解释器修复可能需要 Ascend 更新其前端/interpreter 测试。

commits.comment: 重构 tl.min/tl.max 的 return_indices 归约实现，改为两阶段：先用原生 _elementwise_max/min_ignore_nan 或 _elementwise_max/min_propagate_nan 归约极值（新增 propagate_nan 参数，默认 PropagateNan.NONE，用 static_assert 校验必须是 PropagateNan 枚举值），再用 _argminmax_index 通过「匹配掩码 + 最小索引归约」定位最左匹配下标，从而统一支持 tie_break_left 两种模式（最左匹配对 tie_break_left=True/False 均有效）。移除了 python/triton/language/core.py 中的 _reduce_with_indices 内建函数，删除 standard.py 中的 _argmax_combine/_argmin_combine 系列成对归约函数，all/any 改用 renamed 的 _elementwise_min/max_ignore_nan。interpreter.py 相应简化 min_max 接口，删除 argmin/argmax 的成对归约特例并映射到 np.nanmax/np.max 等。注释指出「Reduce matching indices with min to enable native redux instructions」。权衡：列方向短归约在部分 shape 上有 4%-10% 回退（benchmark 表中 0.91-1.32×）。风险：_reduce_with_indices 被解释器和可能的第三方后端/自定义 combine 引用，删除会破坏向后兼容；新增 propagate_nan 参数改变了 min/max 的签名，第三方的 monkey-patch 需要同步。

ascend_impact.functionality: python/triton/language/core.py 中 _reduce_with_indices 内建函数被删除；python/triton/language/standard.py 的 tl.min/tl.max 签名新增 propagate_nan 参数、内部实现改为两阶段（极值归约 + 最小索引归约），并重命名 _elementwise_max/_elementwise_min → _elementwise_max_ignore_nan/_elementwise_min_ignore_nan，新增 _elementwise_max/min_propagate_nan 和 _argminmax_index。triton-ascend 若在 third_party/ascend/language 或 patch 中引用 _reduce_with_indices/_argmax_combine/_argmin_combine 会直接编译失败；Ascend 的 TritonSemantic.dot monkey-patch 不受影响，但若 Ascend 覆写了 standard.py 相关函数需同步 propagate_nan 语义。TritonToLinalg 转换链的输入 TTIR 形态会因两阶段实现而变化（新引入 _argminmax_index、_elementwise_*_ignore_nan/propagate_nan 等函数调用），可能影响 Ascend 的 lowering 对 reduce 模式识别。

commits.message:
[LANGUAGE] Use two-pass argmin and argmax reductions (#12046)

Reduce the extremum with native min/max, then find the leftmost matching
index. Use this path for both tie modes, support configurable NaN
propagation, and remove the paired-reduction interpreter special cases.
Based on #9840.

### GB300 benchmarks

Default `argmax`, finite row-major 2D inputs with ties, 256–2048
**total** elements, one CTA, four warps. Speedup = main / PR latency;
below 1 is slower. Baseline: main `a34c2ab7c970` (same `standard.py` as
`23b7630da4be`). Both Python implementations use the same installed
Triton 3.8.0 compiler. Medians of 12 paired CUDA-graph rounds, 512
launches each.

| Shape | Axis | FP32 | int32 | int64 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4×64 | 0 | 0.92× | 0.94× | 0.93× |
| 4×64 | 1 | 1.08× | 1.08× | 1.07× |
| 16×16 | 0 | 0.95× | 0.94× | 0.95× |
| 16×16 | 1 | 0.97× | 0.97× | 0.96× |
| 4×128 | 0 | 0.95× | 0.96× | 0.95× |
| 4×128 | 1 | 1.06× | 1.07× | 1.06× |
| 16×32 | 0 | 0.94× | 0.95× | 0.93× |
| 16×32 | 1 | 0.97× | 0.98× | 0.99× |
| 4×256 | 0 | 0.93× | 0.94× | 0.98× |
| 4×256 | 1 | 1.05× | 1.06× | 1.06× |
| 32×32 | 0 | 0.94× | 0.95× | 0.94× |
| 32×32 | 1 | 0.96× | 0.98× | 0.97× |
| 4×512 | 0 | 0.96× | 0.98× | 0.98× |
| 4×512 | 1 | 1.04× | 1.08× | 1.27× |
| 32×64 | 0 | 0.92× | 0.94× | 1.00× |
| 32×64 | 1 | 1.03× | 1.05× | 1.32× |

The full argmin/argmax sweep with both tie modes spans **0.91–1.32×**:
short column reductions still regress, by up to 10%. Identical-code
control noise was <0.6%; no spills.

Validation: all 192 benchmark cases correct; 878 language + 20 Gluon GPU
tests passed; 790 interpreter tests passed (88 BF16 skips).

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit rewrites tl.min/tl.max return_indices (and argmax/argmin) from a single paired reduction to a two-pass scheme, which breaks three Ascend surfaces. (1) Interpreter: in third_party/ascend/backend/ascend_interpreter.py::AscendReduceOps.apply_impl (lines 44-60), replace the removed `tl.standard._argmin_combine_tie_break_left` / `_argmax_combine_tie_break_left` references and the renamed `_elementwise_max`/`_elementwise_min` with the new `_elementwise_{max,min}_ignore_nan` / `_elementwise_{max,min}_propagate_nan` names, and stop calling `self.min_max(input_param[0], val_reduce_op=..., idx_reduce_op=...)`; the base ReduceOps.min_max now has signature `min_max(self, input, reduce_op)` and takes a single numpy reduce fn (np.nanmax/np.max/np.nanmin/np.min). Since the interpreter no longer emits paired (value,index) reductions for argmin/argmax (the index is now computed separately via _argminmax_index), AscendReduceOps should simply dispatch on the renamed _elementwise_* combine fns and delete the arg-index special cases. (2) C++ lowering: the TritonToLinalg ArgMinMaxConverter (include/ and lib/ ArgMinMaxConverter.{h,cpp}) matches a tt.reduce with a 4-argument block (currValue,currIndex,reduceValue,reduceIndex) plus the OEQ/and/slt->or->select tie-break chain; the new frontend emits two single-value tt.reduce ops (extremum via _elementwise_{max,min}_{ignore,propagate}_nan, then an integer min-reduce over where(matches, arange, 0x7fffffff) in _argminmax_index) plus the ==/!= matching logic, so the pattern no longer matches and argmin/argmax silently falls back to the generic reduce path (correctness may survive but the specialized max_with_index/min_with_index linalg lowering, the reduce_mode attribute in getReduceWithIndexParams/addReduceWithIndexAttr, and the FoldOneHotGatherAfterReduceWithIndex top-k/MoE optimization are all dead). The converter must be rewritten to recognize the new two-pass TTIR (match the extremum reduce + the mask/arange/where + min-reduce index computation) and re-express it as the efficient linalg reduce-with-index, or the argmin/argmax and top2gating paths must be re-benchmarked under the generic path. (3) Patch maintenance: rebase the standard.py hunk in third_party/ascend/patch/triton-ascend-3.6.0.patch; it currently anchors on `_elementwise_max`, `input = core._promote_bfloat16_to_float32(input)`, and the old `max/min(input, axis, return_indices, return_indices_tie_break_left, keep_dims)` signature, all of which this commit removes/renames, so the release patch will no longer apply cleanly. Also update Ascend pytest coverage (test_argmax.py, test_argmin.py, test_top2gating_argmax.py, test_unlign_max_with_index.py, test_reduce_min_4_keepdim_True_with_index_op.py) to verify the two-pass path still lowers to the intended max_with_index/min_with_index linalg form on NPU.

commits.comment: 修复 tl.atomic_xchg 在 AMD gfx942/gfx950/gfx1250 上对 fp64 编译失败的问题（AMDGPU 后端只 select i32/i64/f32 buffer swap）。在 BufferOpsEmitter::emitAtomicRMW 中当 rmwType==XCHG 时将 bufferType 改为与向量总位宽相同的整数类型（如 f64→i64、v2f16→i32），依靠 bitcast 保证 swap 只搬位不转换值；同时无符号扩展支持 packed v2f16/v2bf16 交换。python/src/interpreter.cc 的 RMWOp::XCHG 宏扩展支持 float/double。新增 lit 测试（f64/f32/v2f16 swap）与 test_tensor_atomic_xchg 端到端测试，覆盖 -0.0/inf/NaN payload/denormal 等特殊位模式。改动局限在 AMD 后端与解释器绑定，属平台特定代码。

ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。新增测试为 AMD buffer ops lit 测试与通用 test_tensor_atomic_xchg，Ascend 无需同步。

commits.message:
[AMD] Exchange buffer atomic xchg values as integers (#11904)

tl.atomic_xchg on fp64 aborted compilation on gfx942, gfx950 and gfx1250
("Cannot select: ... AMDGPUISD::BUFFER_ATOMIC_SWAP"): ConvertToBufferOps
turns it into a buffer atomic, and the AMDGPU backend only selects i32,
i64 and f32 buffer swaps. A swap only moves bits, so emit it on a scalar
integer of the full value width and bitcast around it. This also covers
packed v2f16/v2bf16 exchanges, which would otherwise become unselectable
v2i16 swaps.

Add lit tests for f64, f32 and v2f16 swaps, and test_tensor_atomic_xchg.
The test exchanges random bit patterns plus -0.0, infinities, NaN
payloads and a denormal, then compares bits. On AMD it also checks that
the buffer swap path is used.

commits.message:
[TOOLS] Match AOT float scalars to ABI widths (#11882)

Map fp32 and f32 to C float, and map fp16 and bf16 to uint16_t. The
16-bit types have no portable C scalar representation, so callers
provide their raw bit patterns. Keep fp64 as double.

The generated launcher now stores each scalar in an object whose width
matches the kernel parameter copied by the driver.

commits.comment: 扩展 FPSan（浮点消毒器）支持 cmpf 比较操作的 payload 语义。在 lib/Dialect/TritonInstrument/Transforms/FpSanitizer.cpp 新增 CmpFOpPattern：将 arith.cmpf 的 OEQ/UEQ→CmpIPredicate::eq、ONE/UNE→ne、OLT/ULT→slt、OLE/ULE→sle、OGT/UGT→sgt、OGE/UGE→sge；ORD→常量 true、UNO→常量 false、AlwaysTrue/AlwaysFalse 处理为常量。通过 embedToInt 把两侧浮点转成有符号整数 payload 后比较，使比较与 FPSan 的 min/max 语义一致（NaN carrier 也参与有序比较）。关键点是在常量折叠之前应用该 pattern 以保留 NaN payload（用 walkAndApplyPatterns）。文档补充 Comparisons 章节，gluon test_fpsan.py 新增 test_cmpf_payload_semantics，test/TritonGPU/fpsan.mlir 新增 cmpf/cmpf_ordering/cmpf_nan_constant 测试。属 TritonInstrument 方言专属路径。

commits.comment: 修复解释器中 tuple 归约在全轴（axis=None）多输入情况下的 bug。原 ReduceOps.unravel 在遍历 input 时对第一个输入 flatten 并设置 axis=0，但后续输入仍是原 shape，导致 generic reducer 用同一 index 读取形状不同的数据而抛 ValueError。修复后先对每个输入 flatten 再统一返回 axis=0，并用 original_ndim（扁平化前首输入的 rank）替代 len(input_shape) 来恢复 keep_dims=True 时的输出形状。test_core.py 的 test_generic_reduction 参数化为 1-D 显式轴、2-D 全轴、3-D 全轴+keep_dims 三种情况，验证 Welford mean/variance 与 tuple/单值 sum。修改 python/triton/runtime/interpreter.py，命中必然影响路径。

commits.message:
[INTERPRETER] Fix tuple reductions over all axes (#12207)

`tl.reduce((x, y), axis=None, combine_fn=...)` fails in the interpreter
for multidimensional inputs. `unravel` sets the shared axis to zero
after flattening the first input, leaving subsequent inputs at their
original shape. The generic reducer then reads differently shaped inputs
with the same index and raises `ValueError`.

Flatten every input before selecting axis zero, and preserve the
original rank when restoring `keep_dims=True`.

The existing `test_generic_reduction` now has three cases: the original
1-D explicit-axis control, a 2-D full reduction, and a 3-D full
reduction with `keep_dims=True`. They compare Welford mean/variance and
tuple/single sums against PyTorch. Removed the added runtime test,
static assertions, and output-shape branching as requested during
review.

Validation:
- Focused Linux CPU A/B at this head: baseline **2 fail / 1 pass**,
patched **3 pass**. Exact test/helper extraction with a CPU fixture.
- Available native runtime is Triton 3.6.0. Both affected baseline
methods match the PR base byte-for-byte; only those two Python methods
were transferred to private package copies. This is not full
current-main or GPU qualification.
- YAPF 0.43.0, focused Ruff, AST parsing and `git diff --check` pass. No
GPU execution or compiler rebuild. Full-suite PASS is not claimed.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: AscendReduceOps (third_party/ascend/backend/ascend_interpreter.py:38) overrides `generic_reduce` (lines 71-127) with a stale copy of the upstream ReduceOps.generic_reduce to implement argmin/argmax local-index semantics, so it does NOT inherit the upstream fix; only `unravel` is inherited and its fix applies automatically. Two edits are needed in AscendReduceOps.generic_reduce to mirror commit 15164f01c564: (1) capture the pre-flatten rank before calling `self.unravel` — add `original_ndim = len(input[0].handle.data.shape)` right after `original_axis = self.axis` (before line 73's `input, axis = self.unravel(...)`), since `unravel` now flattens all inputs when axis is None and `input_shape` becomes the flattened 1-D shape; (2) in the keep_dims pack-output branch (lines 119-121), change `for _ in range(len(input_shape)):` to `for _ in range(original_ndim):` so full-reduction outputs with keep_dims=True are expanded back to the original rank (e.g. (1,1,1) for a 3-D input) instead of only a single leading axis. No changes are required to `unravel` or to `AscendScanOps`/`AscendInterpreterBuilder`.

commits.comment: 升级 LLVM 依赖到 llvm/llvm-project@18f9e623e4c8（从 triton-lang/llvm-project 切回 llvm/llvm-project），包含 NVPTX fptrunc.round 支持与 BF16/FP16 直接转换选择，为后续 llvm-info.json pin 更新和 NVIDIA FpToFpOp 集成做准备。同步修改 .github/workflows/llvm-build.yml：移除 pull_request 触发（PR 构建不发布 SDK），改为只在 main push 和 workflow_dispatch 触发；移除 workflow 自身变更触发重建包的逻辑，改按 changed manifests 与 AMD codegen 源选择包；BASE_SHA/HEAD_SHA 从 pull_request.base/head 回退到 github.event.before/sha；移除 Check LLVM Build Does Not Exist 步骤的 pull_request 条件。属构建/CI 基础设施变更，不影响任何后端编译链。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更文件 .github/workflows/llvm-build.yml（CI 工作流）与 cmake/llvm-build-info.json（LLVM commit pin）为构建/CI 基础设施，不改变任何后端编译链接口。Ascend 若自带 LLVM 依赖 pin（llvm_patch/llvm-info.json）也独立维护，不受此上游 CI 变更影响；但若 Ascend 复用上游 cmake/llvm-build-info.json 的 hash，需自行跟进（不属本 commit 强制传导）。

commits.message:
[LLVM] Build LLVM with NVPTX fptrunc.round support (#12214)

Build
[llvm/llvm-project@18f9e623e4c8](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/commit/18f9e623e4c891ba31ff817c07197707ac9bc593),
which includes [NVPTX support for
`llvm.fptrunc.round`](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/223720)
and direct BF16/FP16 conversion selection.

Run the LLVM build workflow only on relevant pushes to `main` and manual
dispatch. Pull-request builds do not publish SDKs to Azure, so remove
that trigger and its event-specific handling. Package selection follows
the changed manifests and AMD codegen sources; changing the workflow
itself no longer requests rebuilding unchanged packages.

This prepares SDK artifacts for a subsequent `llvm-info.json` pin update
and NVIDIA `FpToFpOp` integration. The consumer pin will be updated once
the packages are published by the post-merge LLVM build workflow.

Validation: the original PR revision passed all eight LLVM SDK builds
and integration CI. For the workflow update, YAML trigger validation,
six package-selection scenarios, `git diff --check`, and repository
pre-commit hooks passed.
